project_info.description: A luxury, artisanal UMKM bookkeeping web app tailored for bouquet, floral arrangement, and custom gift businesses.
project_info.design_archetype: Organic & Earthy with Swiss Precision (Botanical Craft + High-Density Financial Utility)

primary.description: Sage Green - Used for primary headers, navigation accents, main CTA buttons, active state indicators

accent.description: Warm Cream / Vintage Gold - Used for sub-brand 'Bloom & Gift' script text, highlight pills, badge borders, special status highlights

dark_text.description: Deep Forest Slate - Primary dark color for high contrast body text, headings, and key numeric figures

danger.label: Stok Kritis / Pengeluaran / Batal / Belum Bayar (Red)

brand_heading.usage: Main logo text ('Delora'), section titles, modal hero titles, invoice headers, and sub-brand script ('Bloom & Gift')

body_ui.usage: Data tables, form inputs, button labels, badges, financial numbers, tab navigation

mono.usage: Invoice codes (e.g., DEL-2026-0891), order IDs, transaction references

navigation_strategy.desktop: Collapsible sticky sidebar on left with brand header, workspace tenant switcher, 8 menu navigation items with duotone icons, and quick action CTA button.
navigation_strategy.mobile: Fixed top bar with Delora brand logo + tenant switcher, paired with a sticky bottom navigation bar (5 main quick-tabs + 'Lainnya' drawer for full 8 menus). Touch targets >= 44px.

responsive_tables.desktop: Standard dense HTML table with rounded borders, sticky header, multi-column metrics, and hover highlight.
responsive_tables.mobile: Transforms into vertical card list with clean visual separation, expandable details, and quick action buttons.

modules_specification.1_dashboard: KPI metrics (Omset Bulan Ini, Total Pesanan Active, High Margin Item, Alert Stok Kritis), revenue vs expense chart (Recharts bar/area), recent color-coded transactions (Hijau Pemasukan, Merah Pengeluaran), and quick action drawer.
modules_specification.2_inventory: Product & raw material catalog (Bunga Mawar, Wrapping Paper, Ribbon, Flower Box, Custom Card), minimum stock alert banner (Latar Merah Soft + Red Border), stock status badges, add/edit modal with image preview.
modules_specification.3_biaya: Expense tracker with IDR CurrencyInput, category filter (Bahan Baku, Operasional, Transport, Marketing), receipt upload preview, searchable vendor dropdown.
modules_specification.4_penjualan: Sales record table, daily income summary, automatic posting integration from completed orders, IDR formatting.
modules_specification.5_pembelian: Purchase order management for raw materials, supplier list, order status (Pending, Received, Paid).

6_pesanan.description: The flagship complex module featuring 5 distinct tabs and multi-item batch request capabilities.
key_features: Dynamic multi-item row builder (Nama Item, Qty, Harga Invoice, Harga Asli, Subtotal calculation)
Batch multi-order single customer grouping (groupId expand/collapse UI)
Order status pills (Menunggu, Diproses, Merangkai, Siap Kirim, Selesai, Batal)
Payment status pills (Belum Bayar [Red], DP [Amber], Lunas [Green])
Quick View Modal with WhatsApp structured invoice message copy generator and PDF preview simulation
Order Completion Modal that posts sales to Penjualan and reduces Inventory stock automatically

modules_specification.7_customer: Customer database (Regular, VIP, Corporate), transaction history per customer, birthday/anniversary reminder indicators.
modules_specification.8_aset_tetap: Fixed assets ledger (Meja Merangkai, Mobil Operasional, Cold Storage, Scissors Set) with depreciation calculation table (Penyusutan Tahunan) and yearly preview chart.

complex_components.currency_input: IDR formatted auto-parsing text input (e.g. typing 150000 renders as 'Rp 150.000')
complex_components.group_order_accordion: Expandable container displaying batch orders under 1 Customer with total aggregate price tag
complex_components.quick_view_modal: Slide-over or centered dialog showing order breakdown, WhatsApp shareable quote text, and printable invoice style
complex_components.order_completion_modal: Confirmation modal with toggle for 'Post ke Penjualan' and 'Potong Stok Otomatis' with line-item stock check

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modals, tables, badges) MUST include descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='pesanan-tab-bouquet-fresh', data-testid='btn-complete-order-101', data-testid='input-currency-harga-invoice').
testing_and_accessibility.touch_target_min: 44px height/width on all mobile buttons and navigation controls.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_compliance: High contrast ratio with sage green `#8CAA9A` header and `#2E3B34` text ensuring APCA/WCAG AA compliance.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this guidelines file to ensure exact adherence to Delora brand rules, colors, and layout strategies.
2. Implement frontend components in .js/.jsx files inside `/app/frontend/src/`.
3. Use Tailwind CSS utility classes customized with Delora colors (#8CAA9A primary, #E8D9B8 accent, #2E3B34 dark text).
4. Ensure full testability by applying data-testid to every interactive component across all 8 menu screens.
5. Make sure the Pesanan module is fully functional with all 5 tabs, multi-item request rows, WhatsApp/PDF Quick View, and stock deduction Order Completion modal.
